eyebrow: Building the Bell state, two verified steps
code:
state = zero_state(2)              # [1,0,0,0]
state = apply_gate(kron_gate(H,I), state)
# [0.7071 0.  0.7071 0.]

state = apply_gate(CNOT, state)
# [0.7071 0.  0.  0.7071]  -- Bell state
caption: CNOT moves the |10> component to |11> exactly because the control qubit was |1>.
